statement: For how many integers $b \ge 2$ does the base-ten number $2026$ have exactly three digits when it is written in base $b$?

choices.misconception: I mixed up digits with exponents and counted the bases where b^3 is at most 2026 and b^4 is larger, but that is the condition for four digits.
I found the right range 13 through 45 but counted it as 45 - 13 = 32, forgetting to add one for the endpoints.
I took the cube root of 2026, about 12.65, and rounded it down to 12, but 12^3 = 1728 is at most 2026, so base 12 gives four digits.
I only required b^2 to be at most 2026 and forgot that 2026 must also be less than b^3, so I counted every base from 2 to 45.

hints: A base-$b$ number has exactly three digits when it is at least $b^2$ but less than $b^3$.

solutions.reliable: In base $b$ the three-digit numbers are exactly those $N$ with $b^2 \le N < b^3$. The condition $b^2 \le 2026$ means $b \le 45$, since $45^2 = 2025$ and $46^2 = 2116$. The condition $2026 < b^3$ means $b \ge 13$, since $12^3 = 1728$ and $13^3 = 2197$. So $b$ runs from $13$ to $45$, which is $45 - 13 + 1 = 33$ bases.

author: Devansh Sanghavi
